confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge for July 2026 peak season; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is seasonal and volatile. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from beer using typical French lake-town ratios (cocktail about 2.6x beer, wine glass about 1.3x beer). FX: the 2026-10-15 value of 0.6955 came from an rba.gov.au Exchange Rates Overview search snippet and was not verified against the F11 table. Other search snippets showed a different RBA-attributed value (0.7002 for 2026-10-14), so the FX observation should be checked before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-sized French Alpine and lake tourist towns with Geneva-adjacent price levels in peak summer, such as Chambery and Aix-les-Bains, adjusted upward for July demand around Lake Annecy. Drink prices were derived from the beer anchor as described in confidence_notes.
